value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks a lot cooler than today. Expect partly sunny skies and a high around 65°F, about 15 degrees below Monday's 80. Clouds build through the day with a 30% chance of rain after 3 p.m., and showers could move in Tuesday evening. Lows drop into the 30s to low 40s overnight. Breezy from the northeast, with gusts up to 17 mph.
